Similar to it is His saying: ﴿يَأَبَتِ افْعَلْ مَا تُؤْمَرُ سَتَجِدُنِى إنْ شَاءَ اللهُ﴾ ("O my father, do what you are commanded; you will find me, if Allah wills…"), as though it was said to him: "do the command which you are commanded". Had a person or something else been meant by it, it would be permissible even if the bāʾ were not made overt, because the Arabs say: "I command you (āmuruka) and I command for you (āmuru bika)", and "akfuruka and akfuru bika (I disbelieve in you)" with one meaning. The like of it is frequent; of it is their saying:

إذا قالت حَذَامِ فأنصتُوها * فإنّ القول ما قالت حذامِ
(When Ḥadhām speaks, listen to her, for the true word is what Ḥadhām says.)

He meant: "listen to her". And Allah, Blessed and Exalted, said: (أَلاَ إنّ ثَمُودَ كَفَرُوا رَبَّهُمْ) ("surely Thamūd disbelieved their Lord"), which stands in the place of ﴿يكفرون بالله﴾ ("they disbelieve in Allah") [Translator's note: these words are the commentator's, though the text encloses them in Quranic brackets] and (كفروا بربهم) ("they disbelieved in their Lord"). Iṣdaʿ: make your religion manifest.

muyesser-irab:1-1.t:
﴿الر﴾: the discussion of the disjointed letters (al-ḥurūf al-muqaṭṭaʿa) has preceded at the beginning of Sūrat al-Baqara.
﴿تلك آيات الكتاب وقرآن مبين﴾: تلك is the mubtadaʾ (subject); آيات الكتاب is the khabar (predicate); قرآن is conjoined to الكتاب; and مبين is a naʿt (adjective) of القرآن.

muyesser-irab:2-2.t: ﴿ربما يود الذين كفروا لو كانوا مسلمين﴾: ﴿ربما﴾ is [ربّ] restrained [from governing] by [ما] the restraining [particle] (kāffa wa-makfūfa); يود الذين is an imperfect verb and fāʿil (agent); the clause كفروا is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position; ﴿لو﴾ is maṣdar-forming (maṣdariyya) because it occurs after ﴿يود﴾, and together with what it governs it is to be interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) which is the object of the wishing, the meaning being: "they wish their being Muslims". It is also said that ﴿لو﴾ is the [particle] of impossibility (imtināʿiyya), and its apodosis is omitted, its implied form being: «لو كانوا مسلمين لسروا بذلك إذ تخلصوا مما هم فيه» ("had they been Muslims, they would have been glad of it, since they would have been rid of what they are in"); and the object of يود on this interpretation [is omitted], i.e. «ربما يود الذين كفروا النجاة» ("perhaps those who disbelieve will wish for salvation"). [Translator's note: the source sentence «ومفعول يود على هذا التقدير» lacks its predicate; "is omitted" has been supplied from the context.]

muyesser-irab:3-3.t:
﴿ذرهم يأكلوا ويتمتعوا ويلههم الأمل﴾: ذرهم is an imperative verb, a latent (mustatir) agent and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); يأكلوا is a jussive (majzūm) answer, as the answer to the command; يتمتعوا is conjoined to يأكلوا; يلههم الأمل is likewise conjoined; and الأمل is the fāʿil (agent).
﴿فسوف يعلمون﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa; سوف is a particle of futurity; يعلمون is a verb and agent; and the object is omitted, i.e. "the outcome of their affair and the evil of their deeds".

muyesser-irab:4-4.t: ﴿وما أهلكنا من قرية إلا ولها كتاب معلوم﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive (mustaʾnafa) with no grammatical position; ما is negative; أهلكنا is a verb and fāʿil (agent); من is a connective (ṣila) preposition [i.e. redundant]; قرية is genitive in form and accusative in position as the object; إلا is a particle of restriction (adāt ḥaṣr); the wāw is circumstantial; ﴿لها﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); كتاب is the postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); معلوم is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿كتاب﴾; and the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). It is also said that the wāw is a connective [i.e. redundant], and it is also said that the clause ﴿لها كتاب معلوم﴾ is an adjective of قرية.

muyesser-irab:5-5.t: ﴿ما تسبق من أمة أجلها وما يستأخرون﴾: ما is negative; تسبق is an imperfect verb; من is a connective (ṣila) preposition [i.e. redundant]; أمة is the fāʿil (agent) of تسبق in position, genitive in form; أجلها is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and ﴿وما يستأخرون﴾ is conjoined to ﴿ما تسبق﴾.

muyesser-irab:6-6.t: ﴿وقالوا يا أيها الذي نزل عليه الذكر إنك لمجنون﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive (mustaʾnafa) with no grammatical position; قالوا is a verb and fāʿil (agent); the clause ﴿يا أيها الذي نزل...﴾ is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl); يا is the vocative particle; أي is the one addressed (munādā), a specified indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, in the position of an accusative; ها is for alerting (tanbīh); الذي is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿أي﴾; the clause ﴿نزل﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذي, with no grammatical position; ﴿عليه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿نزل﴾; الذكر is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); the kāf is its noun (ism); the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); and مجنون is the khabar (predicate) of إن.

muyesser-irab:7-7.t: ﴿لوما تأتينا بالملائكة إن كنت من الصادقين﴾: لوما is a particle of urging (taḥḍīḍ), like هلا; تأتينا is an imperfect verb, a latent (mustatir) agent and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿بالملائكة﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿تأتينا﴾; إن is conditional; ﴿كنت﴾ is a defective (nāqiṣ), abrogating past verb, and the tāʾ is its noun (ism); ﴿من الصادقين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to its omitted khabar (predicate); and the apodosis of إن is omitted, its implied form being: «ائتنا بالملائكة» ("bring us the angels").

muyesser-irab:8-8.t:
﴿ما ننزل الملائكة إلا بالحق﴾: resumptive speech (kalām mustaʾnaf) with no grammatical position; ما is negative; ننزل is an imperfect verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "we" (نحن); الملائكة is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); إلا is a particle of restriction (adāt ḥaṣr); and ﴿بالحق﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "invested with the truth"; or attached to ﴿ننزل﴾; or it is a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), i.e. «إلا تنزلًا متلبسًا بالحق» ("except with a sending-down invested with the truth").
﴿وما كانوا إذا منظرين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ما is negative; ﴿كانوا﴾ is a defective (nāqiṣ), abrogating past verb, and the wāw is its noun (ism); ﴿إذًا﴾ is a particle of answer and requital, non-governing (muhmal); and منظرين is the khabar (predicate) of كان.

muyesser-irab:9-9.t:
﴿إنا نحن نزلنا الذكر﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); ﴿نا﴾ is its noun (ism); نحن is a tawkīd (emphasis) of the noun of إن, or a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl) with no grammatical position; and the clause نزلنا is the khabar (predicate) of إن.
﴿وإنا له لحافظون﴾: ﴿وإنا﴾ is conjoined; ﴿له﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿حافظون﴾; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); and حافظون is the khabar of إن. Or ﴿نحن﴾ is a pronoun in the position of a nominative as the mubtadaʾ (subject), the clause نزلنا is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ, and the clause ﴿نحن نزلنا﴾ is the khabar of إن.

muyesser-irab:10-10.t: ﴿ولقد أرسلنا من قبلك في شيع الأولين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; the lām is in the answer to an implied (muqaddar) oath; أرسلنا is a verb and fāʿil (agent); ﴿من قبلك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of an omitted mafʿūl bihi (direct object), i.e. "messengers before you"; and ﴿في شيع الأولين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to another omitted adjective of the omitted object.

muyesser-irab:11-11.t: ﴿وما يأتيهم من رسول إلا كانوا به يستهزئون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ما is negative; يأتيهم is a verb and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); من is a connective (ṣila) preposition [i.e. redundant]; رسول is genitive in form and nominative in position as the fāʿil (agent); إلا is a particle of restriction (adāt ḥaṣr); ﴿كانوا﴾ is a defective (nāqiṣ), abrogating past verb, and the wāw is its noun (ism); ﴿به﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿يستهزئون﴾; the clause ﴿يستهزئون﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of كانوا; and the clause ﴿كانوا به يستهزئون﴾ is a ḥāl (circumstantial), or a naʿt (adjective) of رسول.

muyesser-irab:12-12.t: ﴿كذلك نسلكه في قلوب المجرمين﴾: ﴿كذلك﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning «مثل» ("like"), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of an accusative as a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), i.e. "with an inserting like that inserting by which We inserted it into the hearts of the mockers, We insert it into the hearts of the criminals"; ذلك: ﴿ذا﴾ is a demonstrative in the position of a genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), the lām is for distance, and the kāf is a particle of address; ﴿نسلكه﴾ is an imperfect verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "we" (نحن), and the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿في قلوب﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿نسلكه﴾; and ﴿المجرمين﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi.

muyesser-irab:13-13.t:
﴿لا يؤمنون به﴾: the clause is in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial), or it is explicative of His saying ﴿نسلكه﴾ and so has no grammatical position. يؤمنون: an imperfect verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). ﴿به﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿يؤمنون﴾.
﴿وقد خلت سنة الأولين﴾: the wāw is circumstantial; قد is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq); خلت سنة الأولين is a verb and agent; and the clause is circumstantial. It is also said that the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive (mustaʾnafa) with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:14-14.t: ﴿ولو فتحنا عليهم بابا من السماء فظلوا فيه يعرجون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; لو is a conditional [particle] of impossibility (imtināʿiyya); فتحنا is a verb and fāʿil (agent); ﴿عليهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿فتحنا﴾; ﴿بابًا﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿من السماء﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of ﴿بابًا﴾; the fāʾ is a conjunction; ظل is a defective (nāqiṣ), abrogating past verb, and the wāw is its noun (ism); ﴿فيه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يعرجون﴾; and the clause ﴿يعرجون﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of ﴿ظل﴾.

muyesser-irab:15-15.t: ﴿لقالوا إنما سكرت أبصارنا بل نحن قوم مسحورون﴾: the lām occurs in the apodosis of ﴿لو﴾; ﴿قالوا﴾ is a verb and fāʿil (agent); ﴿إنما﴾ is [إنّ] restrained [from governing] by [ما] the restraining [particle] (kāffa wa-makfūfa); سكرت أبصارنا is a verb and agent; the clause has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis of لو; the clause ﴿إنما سكرت أبصارنا﴾ is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl); the clause ﴿نحن قوم مسحورون﴾ follows the clause ﴿سكرت أبصارنا﴾; ﴿بل﴾ is a particle of digression (iḍrāb); نحن is the mubtadaʾ (subject); قوم is the khabar (predicate); and مسحورون is a naʿt (adjective).

muyesser-irab:16-16.t: ﴿ولقد جعلنا في السماء بروجا وزيناها للناظرين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; the lām is the answer to the omitted oath; قد is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq); جعلنا is a verb and fāʿil (agent). It is said that جعلنا means «خلقنا» ("We created"), and His saying ﴿في السماء﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached (mutaʿalliq) to it; and it is said that it means «صيرنا» ("We made [into]"), its first object being ﴿بروجًا﴾, and the preposition and its genitive noun being attached to an omitted [word] which is the second object. زيناها is a verb, agent and mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and ﴿للناظرين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿زيناها﴾.

muyesser-irab:17-17.t: ﴿وحفظناها من كل شيطان رجيم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; حفظناها is a verb, fāʿil (agent) and mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿من كل شيطان رجيم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to حفظناها; and رجيم is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿شيطان﴾.

muyesser-irab:18-18.t: ﴿إلا من استرق السمع فأتبعه شهاب مبين﴾: إلا is a particle of exception; من is a relative noun in the position of an accusative by connected exception (istithnāʾ muttaṣil), or the exception is disconnected (munqaṭiʿ), and what is meant is: prevention from entering it and acting freely in it; the fāʾ is a conjunction; أتبعه is a past verb and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); شهاب is the fāʿil (agent); and مبين is a naʿt (adjective).

muyesser-irab:19-19.t:
﴿والأرض مددناها وألقينا فيها رواسي﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; الأرض is accusative by ishtighāl (preoccupation of the verb), i.e. it is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb indicated by the verb mentioned after it; مددناها is a verb, fāʿil (agent) and direct object; ألقينا is a verb and agent; ﴿فيها﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿ألقينا﴾; and رواسي is the direct object.
﴿وأنبتنا فيها من كل شيء موزون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; أنبتنا is conjoined to what precedes it; ﴿فيها﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أنبتنا﴾; ﴿من كل شيء﴾ is a naʿt (adjective) of the omitted direct object, i.e. "plants of every thing"; and موزون is a naʿt.

muyesser-irab:20-20.t: ﴿وجعلنا لكم فيها معايش ومن لستم له برازقين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; جعلنا is conjoined to what precedes; ﴿لكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿جعلنا﴾, or attached to an omitted second object; ﴿فيها﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); معايش is the object of جعلنا; and the relative ﴿مَن﴾ is conjoined to معايش, or to the position of لكم. It is also said that it is accusative by an omitted, implied verb, its implied form being: «وأغنينا من لستم له برازقين» ("and We have enriched those for whom you are not providers"). And it is also said that the wāw is initial (ibtidāʾiyya), and ﴿مَن﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar (predicate) is omitted, its implied form being: «ومن لستم له برازقين جعلنا له فيها معايش» ("and those for whom you are not providers, We have made for them in it means of living").

muyesser-irab:21-21.t:
﴿وإن من شيء إلا عندنا خزائنه﴾: إن is negative; ﴿من شيء﴾: مِن is a connective (ṣila) [i.e. redundant] in the mubtadaʾ (subject); إلا is a particle of restriction (adāt ḥaṣr); ﴿عندنا﴾ is an adverb attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); خزائنه is the postponed mubtadaʾ; and the clause is the khabar of شيء.
﴿وما ننزله إلا بقدر معلوم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ما is negative; ﴿ننزله﴾ is an imperfect verb, a latent (mustatir) agent and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); إلا is a particle of restriction; ﴿بقدر﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the object, i.e. "invested with a measure", or attached to ﴿ننزله﴾; and معلوم is a naʿt (adjective) of قدر.

muyesser-irab:22-22.t:
﴿وأرسلنا الرياح لواقح﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive (mustaʾnafa) with no grammatical position; أرسلنا الرياح is a verb, fāʿil (agent) and mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and لواقح is an anticipated ḥāl (ḥāl muqaddara, circumstantial) of الرياح.
﴿فأنزلنا من السماء ماء فأسقيناكموه﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; أنزلنا is conjoined to أرسلنا; ﴿من السماء﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿أنزلنا﴾; ماء is the direct object; ﴿فأسقيناكموه﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; أسقى is a past verb; نا is the agent; the kāf is the first direct object; the mīm is the sign of the masculine plural; the wāw is for lengthening (ishbāʿ) the ḍamma of the mīm; and the hāʾ is the second direct object.
﴿وما أنتم له بخازنين﴾: the wāw is circumstantial; ﴿ما﴾ is the Ḥijāzī negative [ما] that governs as ليس does; ﴿أنتم﴾ is the noun (ism) of ما; ﴿له﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿خازنين﴾; ﴿بخازنين﴾: the bāʾ is a connective (ṣila) preposition [i.e. redundant], and ﴿خازنين﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of the Ḥijāzī ﴿ما﴾, accusative in position and genitive by the bāʾ in form.

muyesser-irab:23-23.t:
﴿وإنا لنحن نحيي ونميت﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); ﴿نا﴾ is its noun (ism); the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); نحن is the mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause نحيي is its khabar (predicate); and the clause ﴿نحن نحيي﴾ is the khabar of إن. Or ﴿نحن﴾ is a tawkīd (emphasis) of ﴿نا﴾, and the clause ﴿نحيي﴾ is the khabar of إن.
﴿ونحن الوارثون﴾: نحن is the mubtadaʾ, and الوارثون is the khabar.

muyesser-irab:24-24.t: ﴿ولقد علمنا المستقدمين منكم ولقد علمنا المستأخرين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; the lām is an answer to the omitted oath; قد is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq); علمنا is a verb and fāʿil (agent); المستقدمين is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿منكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); and ﴿ولقد علمنا المستأخرين﴾ is conjoined.

muyesser-irab:25-25.t:
﴿وإن ربك هو يحشرهم﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); ربك is its noun (ism); ﴿هو﴾ is the mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause يحشرهم is the khabar (predicate); and the nominal clause is the khabar of إن.
﴿إنه حكيم عليم﴾: إن is an abrogating particle; the hāʾ is its noun; حكيم is the first khabar, and عليم is the second khabar.

muyesser-irab:26-26.t: ﴿ولقد خلقنا الإنسان من صلصال من حمأ مسنون﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive (mustaʾnafa) with no grammatical position; the lām is an answer to the omitted oath; قد is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq); خلقنا الإنسان is a verb, fāʿil (agent) and mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿من صلصال﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿خلقنا﴾; ﴿من حمأ﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of صلصال, or it is a badal (substitute) from His saying ﴿من صلصال﴾ with the preposition repeated; and مسنون is a naʿt of حمأ.

muyesser-irab:27-27.t: ﴿والجان خلقناه من قبل من نار السموم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; الجان is accusative by ishtighāl (preoccupation of the verb); خلقناه is a verb, fāʿil (agent) and mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿من قبل﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); and ﴿من نار السموم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿خلقناه﴾.

muyesser-irab:28-28.t:
﴿وإذ قال ربك للملائكة﴾: the wāw is resumptive; ﴿إذ﴾ is a noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of an accusative as the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being "remember" (اذكر); the clause ﴿قال ربك﴾ is in the position of a genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), i.e. "remember the time of your Lord's saying"; and ﴿للملائكة﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿قال﴾.
﴿إني خالق بشرا من صلصال من حمأ مسنون﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); the yāʾ is its noun (ism); خالق is its khabar (predicate); بشرًا is the direct object of ﴿خالق﴾; ﴿من صلصال﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to خلقنا [Translator's note: the source says "خلقنا", which is the verb of verse 26; the word in this verse is ﴿خالق﴾. Translated as written.]; ﴿من حمأ﴾ is a naʿt (adjective) of صلصال, or a badal (substitute) from His saying ﴿من صلصال﴾ with the preposition repeated; and مسنون is a naʿt of ﴿حمأ﴾.

muyesser-irab:29-29.t: ﴿فإذا سويته ونفخت فيه من روحي فقعوا له ساجدين﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; ﴿إذا﴾ is a future adverb containing the meaning of condition; the clause ﴿سويته﴾ is in the position of a genitive by the annexation of the adverb to it; نفخت is conjoined to سويته; ﴿فيه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿نفخت﴾; ﴿من روحي﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of an omitted object, i.e. "a spirit from My spirit"; ﴿فقعوا﴾: the fāʾ links (rābiṭa) the answer of إذا, ﴿قعوا﴾ is an imperative verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); ﴿له﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿ساجدين﴾; and ساجدين is a ḥāl (circumstantial).

muyesser-irab:30-30.t: ﴿فسجد الملائكة كلهم أجمعون﴾: the fāʾ conjoins to something omitted, i.e. "so He created him, fashioned him and breathed into him of His spirit, and the angels prostrated"; and ﴿كلهم﴾ and ﴿أجمعون﴾ are tawkīd (emphasis).

muyesser-irab:31-31.t: ﴿إلا إبليس أبى أن يكون مع الساجدين﴾: ﴿أبى﴾ is a past verb; the interpreted maṣdar formed from ﴿أن يكون﴾ is accusative (manṣūb) as the object of ﴿أبى﴾; the noun (ism) of ﴿يكون﴾ is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "he" (هو), i.e. Iblīs; ﴿مع﴾ is an adverb of place attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted khabar (predicate) of ﴿يكون﴾; and الساجدين is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

muyesser-irab:32-32.t: ﴿قال يا إبليس ما لك ألا تكون مع الساجدين﴾: ﴿قال﴾ is a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, and the clause ﴿قال﴾ has no grammatical position; يا is the vocative particle; إبليس is the one addressed (munādā), a singular proper name; ﴿ما﴾ is an interrogative noun for rebuke, the mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿لك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted khabar (predicate); ﴿ألا تكون مع الساجدين﴾: أن is maṣdar-forming and puts [the verb] in the accusative; ﴿لا﴾ is negative; ﴿تكون﴾ is a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb), and its fāʿil (agent) is necessarily latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you" (أنت) [Translator's note: as a defective verb, تكون takes a noun (ism) rather than a fāʿil; the source's wording is kept]; ﴿مع الساجدين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar of تكون; أن and what falls in its scope is accusative by removal of the preposition; and the clause ﴿تكون﴾ is the ṣila of ﴿أن﴾, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:33-33.t: ﴿قال لم أكن لأسجد لبشر خلقته من صلصال من حمأ مسنون﴾: لم is a particle of negation, conversion [of the imperfect to past meaning] and jussive; أكن is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by ﴿لم﴾, and its noun (ism) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "I" (أنا); the lām is the lām of denial (lām al-juḥūd); أسجد is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an أن necessarily implied after it; the interpreted maṣdar formed from أن and the verb is genitive (majrūr) by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted khabar (predicate) of أكن; ﴿لبشر﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أسجد﴾; the clause خلقته is a naʿt (adjective) of بشر; ﴿من صلصال﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿خلقنا﴾ [Translator's note: the source says "خلقنا", carried over from verse 26; the verb in this verse is ﴿خلقته﴾. Translated as written.]; ﴿من حمأ﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt of صلصال, or a badal (substitute) from His saying ﴿من صلصال﴾ with the preposition repeated; and مسنون is a naʿt of ﴿حمأ﴾.

muyesser-irab:34-34.t:
﴿قال فاخرج منها﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa, because it is the answer to an implied (muqaddar) condition, i.e. "if you persist and disobey, then go out"; and ﴿منها﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿اخرج﴾.
﴿فإنك رجيم﴾: the fāʾ gives the reason (taʿlīliyya); إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); the kāf is its noun (ism); رجيم is its khabar (predicate); and the clause has no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:35-35.t: ﴿وإن عليك اللعنة إلى يوم الدين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh) for emphasis; ﴿عليك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to the omitted fronted khabar (predicate) of إن; اللعنة is its postponed noun (ism); and ﴿إلى يوم الدين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "settled until that limit".

muyesser-irab:36-36.t: ﴿قال رب فأنظرني إلى يوم يبعثون﴾: رب is the one addressed (munādā), from which the vocative particle has been omitted, annexed to the yāʾ of the first person; the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa; ﴿إلى يوم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿أنظرني﴾; يبعثون is an imperfect verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive), and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); and the clause يبعثون is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

muyesser-irab:37-37.t: ﴿قال فإنك من المنظرين﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); the kāf is its noun (ism); and ﴿من المنظرين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted khabar (predicate) of إن.

muyesser-irab:38-38.t: ﴿إلى يوم الوقت المعلوم﴾: ﴿إلى يوم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿المنظرين﴾; الوقت is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); and المعلوم is a naʿt (adjective).

muyesser-irab:39-39.t: ﴿قال رب بما أغويتني لأزينن لهم في الأرض ولأغوينهم أجمعين﴾: رب is the one addressed (munādā), from which the vocative particle has been omitted, and it is annexed to the yāʾ of the first person; ﴿بما﴾: the bāʾ is for the oath, and ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdar-forming (maṣdariyya), i.e. "I swear by Your leading me astray", and the clause ﴿لأزينن﴾ is the answer to the oath; it is also said that the bāʾ is causal; ﴿لأزينن﴾: the lām occurs in the answer to an implied (muqaddar) oath, and أزينن is an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa; ﴿لهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿أزينن﴾; ﴿في الأرض﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); ﴿لأغوينهم﴾ is conjoined to ﴿لأزينن﴾; and أجمعين is a tawkīd (emphasis) of the pronoun.

muyesser-irab:40-40.t: ﴿إلا عبادك منهم المخلصين﴾: إلا is a particle of exception; عبادك is the excepted; المخلصين is a naʿt (adjective); and ﴿منهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).

muyesser-irab:41-41.t: ﴿قال هذا صراط علي مستقيم﴾: هذا is the mubtadaʾ (subject); صراط is the khabar (predicate); ﴿عليّ﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted naʿt (adjective), i.e. "binding (ḥaqq)"; and مستقيم is a second naʿt.

muyesser-irab:42-42.t:
﴿إن عبادي ليس لك عليهم سلطان﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); عبادي is its noun (ism); the clause ليس is the khabar (predicate); ﴿لك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to the omitted fronted khabar of ليس; ﴿عليهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); and سلطان is the postponed noun of ليس.
﴿إلا من اتبعك من الغاوين﴾: ﴿مَن﴾ is a relative noun in the position of an accusative by exception; the clause اتبعك is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿مَن﴾, with no grammatical position; and ﴿من الغاوين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl of the fāʿil (agent) of ﴿اتبعك﴾.

muyesser-irab:43-43.t: ﴿وإن جهنم لموعدهم أجمعين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); جهنم is its noun (ism); the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); موعدهم is the khabar (predicate) of إن; and أجمعين is a tawkīd (emphasis) of the pronoun.

muyesser-irab:44-44.t: ﴿لها سبعة أبواب لكل باب منهم جزء مقسوم﴾: ﴿لها﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); سبعة أبواب is the postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿لكل باب﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar; ﴿منهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); جزء is the postponed mubtadaʾ; and مقسوم is a naʿt (adjective) of جزء.

muyesser-irab:45-45.t: ﴿إن المتقين في جنات وعيون﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); المتقين is its noun (ism); ﴿في جنات﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to its omitted khabar (predicate); and عيون is conjoined to جنات.

muyesser-irab:46-46.t: ﴿ادخلوها بسلام آمنين﴾: the clause is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl) of an omitted saying, i.e. "it will be said to them"; ﴿ادخلوها﴾ is an imperative verb, fāʿil (agent) and mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿بسلام﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the wāw in ﴿ادخلوها﴾, i.e. "safe from every harm", or "greeted with peace"; and آمنين is a second ḥāl of the wāw in ﴿ادخلوها﴾.

muyesser-irab:47-47.t: ﴿ونزعنا ما في صدورهم من غل إخوانا على سرر متقابلين﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive (mustaʾnafa) with no grammatical position; نزعنا is a verb and fāʿil (agent); ﴿ما﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿في صدورهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted [verb that is the] ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position; ﴿من غل﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); إخوانًا is a second ḥāl, of ﴿هم﴾; ﴿على سرر﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿متقابلين﴾; and متقابلين is a third ḥāl, of the pronoun in ﴿صدورهم﴾. It is also said that ﴿متقابلين﴾ is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿إخوانًا﴾.

muyesser-irab:48-48.t:
﴿لا يمسهم فيها نصب﴾: the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa) with no grammatical position, or a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the pronoun in ﴿متقابلين﴾ in the previous verse; لا is negative; يمسهم is an imperfect verb and a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and ﴿نصب﴾ is the postponed fāʿil (agent).
﴿وما هم منها بمخرجين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿ما﴾ is the Ḥijāzī negative [ما] that governs as ليس does; ﴿هم﴾ is the noun (ism) of ما; ﴿منها﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿مخرجين﴾; ﴿بمخرجين﴾: the bāʾ is a connective (ṣila) preposition [i.e. redundant], and ﴿مخرجين﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of the Ḥijāzī ﴿ما﴾, accusative in position and genitive by the bāʾ in form.

muyesser-irab:49-49.t: ﴿نبئ عبادي أني أنا الغفور الرحيم﴾: نبئ is an imperative verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); عبادي is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); أن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); the yāʾ is its noun (ism); ﴿أنا﴾ is a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl); الغفور is the khabar (predicate) of أن, and الرحيم is a second khabar. Or ﴿أنا﴾ is the mubtadaʾ (subject), الغفور is the khabar of ﴿أنا﴾, الرحيم is a second khabar, and the clause is the khabar of أن. And أن and what falls in its scope fill the place of the objects of ﴿نبئ﴾.

muyesser-irab:50-50.t: ﴿وأن عذابي هو العذاب الأليم﴾: conjoined to the preceding [clause]; أن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); عذابي is its noun (ism); ﴿هو﴾ is a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl), and العذاب is the khabar (predicate) of أن; or ﴿هو﴾ is the mubtadaʾ (subject), العذاب is the khabar of ﴿هو﴾, and the clause is the khabar of أن; and الأليم is a naʿt (adjective) of العذاب.

muyesser-irab:51-51.t: ﴿ونبئهم عن ضيف إبراهيم﴾: conjoined to ﴿نبئ عبادي﴾; نبئهم is an imperative verb, a latent (mustatir) agent and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and ﴿عن ضيف إبراهيم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿نبئهم﴾.

muyesser-irab:52-52.t: ﴿إذ دخلوا عليه فقالوا سلاما قال إنا منكم وجلون﴾: ﴿إذ﴾ is a noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of an accusative as the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb conjoined to ﴿نبِّئهم﴾, the implied form being: «واذكر إذ دخلوا» ("and remember when they entered"); the clause ﴿دخلوا﴾ is in the position of a genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); ﴿عليه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to دخلوا; ﴿فقالوا﴾ is conjoined to دخلوا; ﴿سلامًا﴾ is a direct object, or a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb, the implied form being: «نسلم سلاما» ("we greet [you] with peace"); ﴿قال﴾ is a past verb; the clause ﴿إنا...﴾ etc. is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl); إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); ﴿نا﴾ is its noun (ism); ﴿منكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿وجلون﴾; and ﴿وجلون﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of إن.

muyesser-irab:53-53.t: ﴿قالوا لا توجل إنا نبشرك بغلام عليم﴾: لا is prohibitive; توجل is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive لا; إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); ﴿نا﴾ is its noun (ism); the clause نبشرك is its khabar (predicate); ﴿بغلام﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿نبشرك﴾; عليم is a naʿt (adjective); and the clause gives the reason for not fearing.

muyesser-irab:54-54.t: ﴿قال أبشرتموني على أن مسني الكبر فبم تبشرون﴾: the hamza is for the interrogative of wonder; بشرتموني is a verb, fāʿil (agent) and mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿على﴾ is a preposition; إن and what falls in its scope is in the position of a genitive by ﴿على﴾ [Translator's note: the source writes «إن»; the particle in the verse is the maṣdar-forming ﴿أن﴾], and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "while it is the case that it has touched me"; الكبر is the agent of مسني; ﴿فبم﴾: the bāʾ is a preposition, ﴿ما﴾ is an interrogative noun, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿تبشرون﴾.

muyesser-irab:55-55.t: ﴿قالوا بشرناك بالحق فلا تكن من القانطين﴾: ﴿بشرناك﴾ is a past verb, fāʿil (agent) and mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the clause ﴿بشرناك﴾ is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl); ﴿بالحق﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿بشرناك﴾; the fāʾ is a conjunction; لا is prohibitive; تكن is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive لا, and the noun (ism) of تكن is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you" (أنت); and ﴿من القانطين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:56-56.t: ﴿قال ومن يقنط من رحمة ربه إلا الضالون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; من is an interrogative noun whose meaning is negation, in the position of a nominative as the mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause يقنط is its khabar (predicate); ﴿من رحمة ربه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿يقنط﴾; إلا is a particle of restriction (adāt ḥaṣr); and الضالون is a badal (substitute) from the latent (mustatir) pronoun in يقنط, a substitution of part for whole.

muyesser-irab:57-57.t: ﴿قال فما خطبكم أيها المرسلون﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; ما is an interrogative noun, the mubtadaʾ (subject); خطبكم is the khabar (predicate), i.e. "what is your business?"; ﴿أي﴾ is the one addressed (munādā), a specified indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), and the vocative particle is omitted; ها is for alerting (tanbīh); and المرسلون is a ṣifa (adjective) of ﴿أي﴾, or a naʿt of ﴿أيها﴾.

muyesser-irab:58-58.t: ﴿قالوا إنا أرسلنا إلى قوم مجرمين﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); ﴿نا﴾ is its noun (ism); the clause أرسلنا is its khabar (predicate); ﴿نا﴾ is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) of أرسل; ﴿إلى قوم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿أرسلنا﴾; and ﴿مجرمين﴾ is a naʿt (adjective).

muyesser-irab:59-59.t: ﴿إلا آل لوط إنا لمنجوهم أجمعين﴾: ﴿آل لوط﴾ is excepted from the hidden (mustakinn) pronoun in ﴿مجرمين﴾ in the previous verse, and the clause ﴿إنا لمنجوهم﴾ is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya) with no grammatical position; or [آل لوط] is a disconnected excepted (mustathnā munqaṭiʿ), accusative (manṣūb).

muyesser-irab:60-60.t: ﴿إلا امرأته قدرنا إنها لمن الغابرين﴾: إلا امرأته is excepted from آل لوط, or excepted from the object pronoun in منجوهم; ﴿قدرنا﴾ is a verb and fāʿil (agent), and it has been made to contain the meaning of knowing; إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); the hāʾ is its noun (ism); the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); and ﴿من الغابرين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted khabar (predicate) of إن.

muyesser-irab:61-61.t: ﴿فلما جاء آل لوط المرسلون﴾: the fāʾ conjoins to something omitted, i.e. "so they left him and travelled from his town to the town of the people of Lot"; لما is temporal (ḥīniyya) or linking (rābiṭa); جاء is a past verb; آل لوط is the fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and المرسلون is the postponed fāʿil (agent).

muyesser-irab:62-62.t: ﴿قال إنكم قوم منكرون﴾: the clause has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition; إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); the kāf is its noun (ism); قوم is its khabar (predicate); and منكرون is a naʿt (adjective) of قوم.

muyesser-irab:63-63.t: ﴿قالوا بل جئناك بما كانوا فيه يمترون﴾: بل is a particle of digression (iḍrāb) and conjunction; جئناك is a verb, fāʿil (agent) and mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿بما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿جئناك﴾; the clause كانوا is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; ﴿فيه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يمترون﴾; and the clause يمترون is the khabar (predicate) of كانوا.

muyesser-irab:64-64.t: ﴿وأتيناك بالحق وإنا لصادقون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; أتيناك is a verb, fāʿil (agent) and mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿بالحق﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "[we] being invested [with it]", or "you being invested [with it]" because of your seeing it; or attached to ﴿أتيناك﴾; إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); ﴿نا﴾ is its noun (ism); the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); and صادقون is the khabar (predicate) of إن.

muyesser-irab:65-65.t:
﴿فأسر بأهلك بقطع من الليل﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa; أسر is an imperative verb, and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you" (أنت); ﴿بأهلك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); ﴿بقطع﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أسر﴾; and ﴿من الليل﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of قطع.
﴿واتبع أدبارهم ولا يلتفت منكم أحد وامضوا حيث تؤمرون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; اتبع is conjoined to ﴿فأسر﴾; أدبارهم is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the wāw is a conjunction; لا is prohibitive; يلتفت is jussive (majzūm) by لا; ﴿منكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl; أحد is the agent; امضوا is likewise conjoined; ﴿حيث﴾ is a vague adverb in the position of an accusative as the object of ﴿امضوا﴾; and the clause تؤمرون is that to which the adverb is annexed (muḍāf ilayhi).

muyesser-irab:66-66.t: ﴿وقضينا إليه ذلك الأمر أن دابر هؤلاء مقطوع مصبحين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; قضينا is a verb and fāʿil (agent); ﴿إليه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿قضينا﴾, because it has been made to contain the meaning of «أوحينا» ("We revealed"); ﴿ذلك﴾ is the object of قضينا; الأمر is a badal (substitute) from the demonstrative; ﴿أن﴾ is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); دابر is its noun (ism); مقطوع is its khabar (predicate); the interpreted maṣdar formed from ﴿أن﴾ and what falls in its scope is a badal from ﴿ذلك الأمر﴾, or the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject); and ﴿مصبحين﴾ is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the pronoun lodged (mustaqirr) in ﴿مقطوع﴾.

muyesser-irab:67-67.t: ﴿وجاء أهل المدينة يستبشرون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; جاء أهل المدينة is a verb and fāʿil (agent); and the clause يستبشرون is a ḥāl (circumstantial).

muyesser-irab:68-68.t: ﴿قال إن هؤلاء ضيفي فلا تفضحون﴾: ﴿قال﴾ is a past verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun; ﴿إن﴾ is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); هؤلاء is its noun (ism); ضيفي is its khabar (predicate); the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa; لا is prohibitive; تفضحون is jussive (majzūm) by ﴿لا﴾, and the wāw is the agent; the nūn is for protection (nūn al-wiqāya); and the yāʾ, omitted in keeping with the verse-endings (fawāṣil), is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

muyesser-irab:69-69.t: ﴿واتقوا الله ولا تخزون﴾: conjoined to what precedes; ﴿اتقوا الله﴾: a verb, fāʿil (agent) and mafʿūl bihi (direct object); لا is prohibitive; تخزون is jussive (majzūm) by لا, and the wāw is the agent; the nūn is the nūn of protection (nūn al-wiqāya); and the yāʾ, omitted in keeping with the verse-endings (fawāṣil), is the direct object.

muyesser-irab:70-70.t: ﴿قالوا أولم ننهك عن العالمين﴾: the hamza is interrogative; the wāw conjoins to something omitted; لم is a particle of negation, conversion [of the imperfect to past meaning] and jussive; ننهك is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لم; the kāf is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and ﴿عن العالمين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿ننهك﴾.

muyesser-irab:71-71.t: ﴿قال هؤلاء بناتي إن كنتم فاعلين﴾: هؤلاء بناتي is a mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate), and something omitted must be supplied, i.e. "so marry them"; or ﴿هؤلاء﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an implied (muqaddar) verb, i.e. "marry these", and بناتي is a badal (substitute); إن is conditional; ﴿كنتم﴾ is a defective (nāqiṣ), abrogating past verb, the tāʾ is its noun (ism), and it is in the position of a jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); فاعلين is the khabar of كنتم; and the apodosis of إن is omitted, indicated by what precedes it, i.e. "then marry them".

muyesser-irab:72-72.t: ﴿لعمرك إنهم لفي سكرتهم يعمهون﴾: the lām is the lām of inception (lām al-ibtidāʾ); عمرك is a mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar (predicate) is necessarily omitted, its implied form being "is my oath" (قسمي); the clause ﴿إنهم...﴾ is the answer to the oath, with no grammatical position; إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); the hāʾ is its noun (ism); the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); ﴿في سكرتهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted khabar; and the clause ﴿يعمهون﴾ is in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the pronoun in ﴿في سكرتهم﴾, or of what the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to. And the clause ﴿لعمرك إنهم لفي سكرتهم يعمهون﴾ is parenthetical (iʿtirāḍiyya), with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:73-73.t: ﴿فأخذتهم الصيحة مشرقين﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; ﴿أخذتهم الصيحة﴾ is a verb, mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and fāʿil (agent); and مشرقين is a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "entering upon sunrise".

muyesser-irab:74-74.t: ﴿فجعلنا عاليها سافلها وأمطرنا عليهم حجارة من سجيل﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, the conjunction being consequent upon the seizing by the Cry; ﴿جعلنا﴾ is a verb and fāʿil (agent); عاليها is the first object of ﴿جعلنا﴾, and سافلها is the second object of جعلنا; أمطرنا is conjoined to جعلنا; حجارة is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿عليهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿أمطرنا﴾; and ﴿من سجيل﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of حجارة.

muyesser-irab:75-75.t: ﴿إن في ذلك لآيات للمتوسمين﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); ﴿في ذلك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to its omitted fronted khabar (predicate); the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); آيات is its noun (ism); and ﴿للمتوسمين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿آيات﴾; it is also said: attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of ﴿آيات﴾.

muyesser-irab:76-76.t: ﴿وإنها لبسبيل مقيم﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); the hāʾ is its noun (ism); the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); ﴿بسبيل﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted khabar (predicate); and ﴿مقيم﴾ is a naʿt (adjective).

muyesser-irab:77-77.t: ﴿إن في ذلك لآية للمؤمنين﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); ﴿في ذلك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to its omitted fronted khabar (predicate); the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); آية is its noun (ism); and ﴿للمؤمنين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿آية﴾; it is also said: attached to a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿آية﴾.

muyesser-irab:78-78.t: ﴿وإن كان أصحاب الأيكة لظالمين﴾: the wāw: resumptive or a conjunction; ﴿إن﴾: lightened from the heavy [إنّ], non-governing (muhmala); كان is a defective (nāqiṣ), abrogating past verb; أصحاب is its noun (ism); الأيكة is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the lām is the distinguishing lām (al-lām al-fāriqa); ظالمين is the khabar (predicate) of كان; and the clause ﴿وإن كان أصحاب...﴾ is resumptive (mustaʾnafa) with no grammatical position, or conjoined.

muyesser-irab:79-79.t:
﴿فانتقمنا منهم﴾: the fāʾ conjoins to something omitted, i.e. "they went far in sin, so We took retribution"; انتقمنا is a verb and fāʿil (agent); and ﴿منهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿انتقمنا﴾.
﴿وإنهما لبإمام مبين﴾: the wāw is circumstantial or a conjunction; ﴿إنهما﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the hāʾ is its noun (ism); the pronoun refers back to the towns of the people of Lot and al-Ayka; it is also said that they refer to al-Ayka and Madyan, because Shuʿayb was sent to both; it is also said that it refers to Lot and Shuʿayb; and it is also said that it refers to the two reports: the report of the destruction of the people of Lot and the report of the destruction of the people of Shuʿayb; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); ﴿بإمام﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) of ﴿إنهما﴾; and مبين is its naʿt (adjective).

muyesser-irab:80-80.t: ﴿ولقد كذب أصحاب الحجر المرسلين﴾: conjoined to what precedes; the lām occurs in the answer to an implied (muqaddar) oath; قد is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq); ﴿كذب أصحاب الجحر﴾ [Translator's note: the source writes «الجحر»; the word in the verse is ﴿الحجر﴾] is a verb and fāʿil (agent); and المرسلين is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

muyesser-irab:81-81.t:
﴿وآتيناهم آياتنا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; آتيناهم is a verb, fāʿil (agent) and first mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and آياتنا is the second direct object.
﴿فكانوا عنها معرضين﴾: ﴿فكانوا﴾ is conjoined to آتيناهم; كانوا is a defective (nāqiṣ), abrogating past verb, and the wāw is its noun (ism); ﴿عنها﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to معرضين; and معرضين is the khabar (predicate) of كانوا.

muyesser-irab:82-82.t: ﴿وكانوا ينحتون من الجبال بيوتا آمنين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; كانوا is a defective (nāqiṣ), abrogating past verb; the wāw is its noun (ism); the clause ينحتون is its khabar (predicate); ﴿من الجبال﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), or to ﴿ينحتون﴾; بيوتًا is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and آمنين is a ḥāl of the pronoun in ﴿ينحتون﴾.

muyesser-irab:83-83.t: ﴿فأخذتهم الصيحة مصبحين﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; أخذتهم is a verb and a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object); الصيحة is the postponed fāʿil (agent); and مصبحين is a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "entering upon the time of morning".

muyesser-irab:84-84.t: ﴿فما أغنى عنهم ما كانوا يكسبون﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; ما is negative; أغنى is a past verb; ﴿عنهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿أغنى﴾; ﴿ما﴾ is the fāʿil (agent); the clause كانوا is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; and the clause يكسبون is the khabar (predicate) of كانوا. It is also said that the first ﴿ما﴾ is interrogative, a fronted object of ﴿أغنى﴾; and it is also said [that it, i.e. the second ما,] is maṣdar-forming (maṣdariyya). [Translator's note: the source says only «وقيل: مصدرية» ("and it is said: maṣdar-forming"); the bracketed referent is the translator's reading.]

muyesser-irab:85-85.t:
﴿وما خلقنا السماوات والأرض وما بينهما إلا بالحق﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ما is negative; خلقنا السماوات is a verb, fāʿil (agent) and mafʿūl bihi (direct object); الأرض is conjoined to السماوات; إلا is a particle of restriction (adāt ḥaṣr); and ﴿بالحق﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), the bāʾ being for accompaniment (mulābasa), i.e. "invested with the truth".
﴿وإن الساعة لآتية﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); الساعة is its noun (ism); the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); and آتية is its khabar (predicate).
﴿فاصفح الصفح الجميل﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa; اصفح is an imperative verb, and its agent is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you" (أنت); الصفح is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object); and الجميل is a naʿt (adjective).

muyesser-irab:86-86.t: ﴿إن ربك هو الخلاق العليم﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); ربك is its noun (ism); الخلاق and العليم are its two khabars (predicates); and ﴿هو﴾ is a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl).

muyesser-irab:87-87.t: ﴿ولقد آتيناك سبعا من المثاني والقرآن العظيم﴾: resumptive speech (kalām mustaʾnaf) with no grammatical position; the lām is an answer to the omitted oath; قد is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq); آتيناك is a past verb, fāʿil (agent) and first mafʿūl bihi (direct object); سبعًا is the second direct object; ﴿من المثاني﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of ﴿سبعًا﴾; القرآن is conjoined to ﴿سبعًا﴾; and العظيم is a naʿt of القرآن.

muyesser-irab:88-88.t:
﴿لا تمدن عينيك إلى ما متعنا به أزواجا منهم﴾: لا is prohibitive; تمدن is an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa because it is attached to the heavy nūn of emphasis, and it is in the position of a jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive لا; the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you" (أنت); عينيك is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿إلى ما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿تمدن﴾; the clause ﴿متعنا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; ﴿به﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿متعنا﴾; أزواجًا is the object of متعنا; and ﴿منهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of ﴿أزواجًا﴾.
﴿ولا تحزن عليهم واخفض جناحك للمؤمنين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; لا تحزن is conjoined to لا تمدن; ﴿عليهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تحزن﴾; اخفض is likewise conjoined; جناحك is the direct object; and ﴿للمؤمنين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿اخفض﴾.

muyesser-irab:89-89.t: ﴿وقل إني أنا النذير المبين﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); the yāʾ is its noun (ism); ﴿أنا﴾ is a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl), and ﴿النذير﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of إن; or ﴿أنا﴾ is the mubtadaʾ (subject), النذير is the khabar of ﴿أنا﴾, and the clause ﴿أنا النذير﴾ is the khabar of إن; and المبين is a naʿt (adjective).

muyesser-irab:90-90.t: ﴿كما أنزلنا على المقتسمين﴾: ﴿كما﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning «مثل» ("like"), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of an accusative as a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), its implied form being: «آتيناك سبعا من المثانى إيتاءً مثلَ ما أنزلنا» ("We have given you seven of the oft-repeated with a giving like what We sent down"), or «إنزالا مثلَ ما أنزلنا» ("with a sending-down like what We sent down"), because آتيناك has the meaning of «أنزلنا عليك» ("We sent down to you"). It is also said that the kāf is in the position of an accusative as a naʿt of an object, its implied form being: «إني أنذركم عذابًا مثلَ العذاب المنزل على المقتسمين» ("I warn you of a punishment like the punishment sent down upon the dividers"). ﴿ما﴾ is a relative noun in the position of a genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause ﴿أنزلنا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative, with no grammatical position; and ﴿على المقتسمين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿أنزلنا﴾.

muyesser-irab:91-91.t: ﴿الذين جعلوا القرآن عضين﴾: الذين is a naʿt (adjective) of المقتسمين; the clause جعلوا is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position; القرآن is the object of جعلوا; and عضين is the second mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

muyesser-irab:92-92.t: ﴿فوربك لنسألنهم أجمعين﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; the wāw is for the oath; ﴿ربك﴾ is genitive (majrūr) by the wāw of the oath, and the preposition and its genitive noun are a preposition and its genitive noun attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted verb, its implied form being "I swear" (أقسم); the lām occurs in the answer to the oath; ﴿لنسألنهم﴾: a verb, a latent (mustatir) agent and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and أجمعين is a tawkīd (emphasis).

muyesser-irab:93-93.t: ﴿عما كانوا يعملون﴾: ﴿عما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿لنسألنهم﴾; كان is a defective (nāqiṣ), abrogating past verb; the wāw is its noun (ism); the clause يعملون is its khabar (predicate); and the clause ﴿كانوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:94-94.t: ﴿فاصدع بما تؤمر وأعرض عن المشركين﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa, i.e. "if you know this, then proclaim"; ﴿اصدع﴾ is an imperative verb, and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you" (أنت); ﴿بما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to it, and ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdar-forming (maṣdariyya) or relative (mawṣūla); and ﴿عن المشركين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أعرض﴾.

muyesser-irab:95-95.t: ﴿إنا كفيناك المستهزئين﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); ﴿نا﴾ is its noun (ism); ﴿كفيناك﴾ is a verb, fāʿil (agent) and mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿كفيناك﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of إن; and المستهزئين is the second direct object.

muyesser-irab:96-96.t:
﴿الذين يجعلون مع الله إلها آخر﴾: الذين is a naʿt (adjective) of المستهزئين; the clause يجعلون is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); ﴿مع الله﴾ is an adverb of place attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted second mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of ﴿يجعلون﴾; إلهًا is the direct object; and آخر is a naʿt.
﴿فسوف يعلمون﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive (mustaʾnafa) with no grammatical position; سوف is a particle of futurity; يعلمون is an imperfect verb and agent; and the object is omitted, i.e. "the outcome of their affair".

muyesser-irab:97-97.t: ﴿ولقد نعلم أنك يضيق صدرك بما يقولون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; the lām occurs in an answer to the oath; قد is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq); نعلم is an imperfect verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "we" (نحن); ﴿أنك﴾: أن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the kāf is its noun (ism); it and what falls in its scope fill the place of the two objects of نعلم; the clause يضيق صدرك is the khabar (predicate) of أن, and صدرك is the agent of يضيق; ﴿بما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿يضيق﴾; and the clause ﴿يقولون﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position, and the referent pronoun (ʿāʾid) is omitted, i.e. "what they say of sayings".

muyesser-irab:98-98.t: ﴿فسبح بحمد ربك وكن من الساجدين﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa; ﴿بحمد ربك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "while you praise your Lord for having granted you success in glorifying [Him] and helped you in it"; ﴿وكن﴾ is a defective (nāqiṣ), abrogating imperative verb, and its noun (ism) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun; من is a preposition, and الساجدين is a genitive noun; and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) of كن.

muyesser-irab:99-99.t: ﴿واعبد ربك حتى يأتيك اليقين﴾: حتى is a particle of limit and a preposition; يأتيك is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after حتى; the interpreted maṣdar formed from ﴿أن﴾ and the verb is genitive (majrūr) by the lām [Translator's note: so in the source; the preposition here is حتى, not a lām]; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿اعبد﴾; the kāf is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and اليقين is the fāʿil (agent).

zajjaj:70-70.t: ﴿قالُوا أوَلَمْ نَنْهَكَ عَنِ العالَمِينَ﴾: its meaning is: "Did we not forbid you from giving hospitality to all people (العالمين)?"

zajjaj:71-71.t: ﴿قالَ هَؤُلاءِ بَناتِي إنْ كُنْتُمْ فاعِلِينَ﴾: the answer is construed according to the sense, because they wanted the guests for depravity, so Lot said to them: "These are my daughters (هؤلاء بناتي)", because the women of every prophet's community stand in the place of his daughters, and his wives stand in the place of their mothers. The meaning is: "Women, by way of marriage, are purer for you." And the meaning of "إن كنتم فاعلين" is: "If you intend this matter, then take to marrying my daughters."

zajjaj:72-72.t:
﴿لَعَمْرُكَ إنَّهم لَفي سَكْرَتِهِمْ يَعْمَهُونَ﴾: this verse is a great verse in showing the excellence of the Prophet ﷺ — I mean His words, glory be to Him: "لعمرك". It has come in the tafsīr (exegesis) that it is an oath by the life of Muhammad ﷺ; this is what most of the exegesis says.

It has also come in some exegesis that "لعمرك" is a word from the speech of the Arabs. I do not like this explanation, because saying "a word from the speech of the Arabs" conveys no benefit, since the whole Quran is clear Arabic and its words are from the speech of the Arabs; so one must inevitably say: what is its meaning? Sībawayh, al-Khalīl and all the authorities on the language said: "العَمْر" and "العُمْر" have one and the same meaning (life); but when it is used in an oath, its first letter is given fatḥa and nothing else — the Arabs say only "لَعَمْرُك". They preferred the fatḥa in the oath only because the fatḥa is lighter for them, and they swear very often by "لعمري" and "لعمرك"; so when their use of it became frequent, they adhered to what was lighter for them.

The grammarians said: "لعمرك" is nominative (marfūʿ) by being the mubtadaʾ (subject), and the khabar (predicate) is omitted; the meaning is: "By your life is my oath (لعمرك قسمي)" and "By your life is what I swear by (لعمرك ما أقسم به)". The khabar was omitted because there is an indication of it in the speech. The meaning is: "I swear that they are wandering blindly in their intoxication." The meaning of "يعمهون" is: they are bewildered. In the chapter of the oath the verb may be omitted: you say "واللهِ لأفعلنّ" (by Allah, I will surely do it) and "تاللهِ لأفعلنّ", and the meaning is: I swear by Allah, and "I swear, by Allah (أحلف والله)"; so "أحلف" (I swear) is omitted because the person addressed knows that you are swearing. In the same way the khabar of the mubtadaʾ is omitted, as we have mentioned.

zajjaj:73-73.t: His words: ﴿فَأخَذَتْهُمُ الصَّيْحَةُ مُشْرِقِينَ﴾, that is: the Cry seized the people of Lot with punishment at sunrise (مشرقين). One says: "أشرقنا فنحن مشرقون" (we came upon sunrise, so we are at sunrise), when they meet the rising (شروق) of the sun, which is its coming up — just as you say "أصبحنا" (we came upon morning) when they meet the morning. One says "شَرَقَت الشمس" when it rises, and "أشرقت" has the same meaning; except that the meaning of "مشرقين" is "meeting the rising of the sun".

zajjaj:74-74.t: His words: ﴿وَأمْطَرْنا عَلَيْهِمْ حِجارَةً مِن سِجِّيلٍ﴾: the meaning of "من سجّيل" is: of clay with writing upon it, and its derivation is from "السِّجِلّ" (the written register). The proof of this explanation is His words: ﴿حِجارَةً مِن طِينٍ﴾ [al-Dhāriyāt: 33] ﴿مُسَوَّمَةً عِنْدَ رَبِّكَ﴾ [al-Dhāriyāt: 34]: He made known that they are of clay, and that they are "مسوّمة", that is: marked, with the marks of writing.

zajjaj:75-75.t: ﴿إنَّ في ذَلِكَ لآياتٍ لِلْمُتَوَسِّمِينَ﴾: it was said: "المتوسّمون" are those who discern by physiognomy (المتفرّسون); and it was said: "those who reflect (المتفكّرون)". Its real meaning in the language is: "المتوسّمون" are the observers who are careful and steady in their looking, until they recognise the true mark (سِمة) of a thing. You say: "توسّمتُ في فلان كذا وكذا" (I discerned such-and-such in so-and-so), that is: I recognised the mark (وَسْم) of that in him.

zajjaj:76-76.t: ﴿وَإنَّها لَبِسَبِيلٍ مُقِيمٍ﴾, that is: on a clear, evident road.

zajjaj:77-77.t: ﴿إنَّ في ذَلِكَ لآيَةً لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾, that is: a clear sign for those who believe (المصدّقين).

zajjaj:78-78.t: ﴿وَإنْ كانَ أصْحابُ الأيْكَةِ لَظالِمِينَ﴾, that is: the people of the trees; "الأيك" means trees. These were the people of a place that had trees, and Allah took vengeance on them for their disbelief. It was said that heat seized them for some days, then the place blazed up upon them in fire, and they perished to the last of them. The meaning of "إنْ" together with the lām is emphasis (tawkīd).

zajjaj:79-79.t: ﴿وَإنَّهُما لَبِإمامٍ مُبِينٍ﴾, that is: on a road that is followed (يُؤتمّ), that is: that is headed for, so it is clear. And "أصحاب الحجر" (the people of al-Ḥijr) are the people of a valley called "الحِجر".

zajjaj:87-87.t:
His words: ﴿وَلَقَدْ آتَيْناكَ سَبْعًا مِنَ المَثانِي والقُرْآنَ العَظِيمَ﴾: it was said: the seven of al-mathānī are the Opening of the Book (al-Fātiḥa), which is seven verses. It was called "المثاني" only because it is repeated (يُثنّى بها) in every rakʿa of the rakʿas of the prayer, and it is repeated along with whatever else of the Quran is recited. And it is possible — and Allah knows best — that "من المثاني" means: of that with which Allah is praised (أُثني به على الله), because it contains the praise of Allah, His oneness, the mention of His angels, and His sovereignty on the Day of Judgement.

It is related in the exegesis that no community was given anything like what the community of Muhammad ﷺ was given in the sūra "al-Ḥamd". As for the entry of "مِن", here it is of two kinds. It may be partitive (li-l-tabʿīḍ): "of the Quran", that is: "We have given you seven verses out of the whole of the verses with which Allah, Mighty and Majestic, is praised, and We have given you the Mighty Quran." And it is possible that the seven are themselves the mathānī, and "مِن" is descriptive (al-ṣifa), as He, Mighty and Majestic, said: ﴿فاجْتَنِبُوا الرِّجْسَ مِنَ الأوْثانِ﴾ [al-Ḥajj: 30]; the meaning is: "Avoid the idols", not that some of them are filth.

On this analogy the meaning may be "seven mathānī (سبعًا مثاني)". The first view is supported by His words, Mighty and Majestic: ﴿اللَّهُ نَـزَّلَ أحْسَنَ الحَدِيثِ كِتابًا مُتَشابِهًا مَثانِيَ﴾ [al-Zumar: 23]. It was also said: "سبعًا من المثاني" are the seven long sūras: from "al-Baqara" to "al-Aʿrāf" are six, and they differed about the seventh: some said it is the sūra "Yūnus", and it was said: "al-Anfāl" and "Barāʾa". They were called "مثاني" only because the stories are mentioned in them repeatedly (مثنّاة). It is grammatically permissible to say "والقرآنِ العظيم" in the genitive (bi-l-khafḍ), but do not recite it that way unless a sound transmission of it is established.

zajjaj:88-88.t: ﴿أزْواجًا مِنهُمْ﴾, that is: likes (classes) in enjoyments. ﴿واخْفِضْ جَناحَكَ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾, that is: "Be gentle in your manner towards the believers", that is: towards whoever believes in you and in what you have brought.

zajjaj:90-90.t: ﴿كَما أنْـزَلْنا عَلى المُقْتَسِمِينَ﴾ ﴿الَّذِينَ جَعَلُوا القُرْآنَ عِضِينَ﴾ [al-Ḥijr: 91]: it is related that the idolaters said: "Tales of the ancients", and they said: "Sorcery", and they said: "A poet", and they said: "A soothsayer"; so they divided it into these divisions and split it into parts (عضَوه أعضاءً). It is also related that the People of the Book are those who made divisions (المقتسمون): they believed in part of it and disbelieved in part of it, and they said something similar to what is related of the idolaters.

zajjaj:94-94.t:
﴿فاصْدَعْ بِما تُؤْمَرُ﴾: it was said in the exegesis: proclaim the Quran openly. And it may be — and Allah knows best — that "فاصدع بما تؤمر" means: make clear what you are commanded and make it manifest. That is taken from "الصَّدِيع", which is "the dawn (الصبح)". The poet said:
؎كَأنَّ بَياضَ غُرَّتِهِ الصَّدِيعُ
(As if the whiteness of his blaze were the dawn.)
The interpretation of "الصَّدْع" in glass or in a wall is: that part of a thing becomes separated from another part.

zajjaj:95-95.t: ﴿إنّا كَفَيْناكَ المُسْتَهْزِئِينَ﴾: it was said: these were a group of the idolaters, five men, who used to mock the Messenger of Allah ﷺ; afflictions befell them, from which most of them died, and one of them became blind. The five are named in the exegesis; among them are al-Walīd ibn al-Mughīra, al-ʿĀṣ ibn Wāʾil, ʿAdī ibn Qays, al-Aswad ibn al-Muṭṭalib and al-Aswad ibn ʿAbd Yaghūth. Allah made known that they were among the idolaters by His words: ﴿الَّذِينَ يَجْعَلُونَ مَعَ اللَّهِ إلَهًا آخَرَ﴾ [al-Ḥijr: 96].

zajjaj:99-99.t:
His words, Mighty and Majestic: ﴿واعْبُدْ رَبَّكَ حَتّى يَأْتِيَكَ اليَقِينُ﴾, that is: until death comes to you, as Jesus son of Mary said: ﴿وَأوْصانِي بِالصَّلاةِ والزَّكاةِ ما دُمْتُ حَيًّا﴾ [Maryam: 31].

If someone asks: how can there be worship by one who is not alive? — that is, how can a person worship while he is dead? — then the usage (majāz) of this speech is the usage of "forever (أبدًا)". The meaning is: worship your Lord forever, and worship Him until death; because if it had been said "Worship your Lord" without a time limit, it would have been possible, if a person worshipped once, for him to be obedient. So when He said "حتى يأتيك اليقين", that is: forever, and as long as you live, then you have been commanded to persist in worship.

zajjaj:2-2.t:
Sūrat al-Ḥijr
Meccan
﷽
His saying: ﴿رُبَما يَوَدُّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا﴾: it was read ”رُبَّما يَوَدُّ“, with the bāʾ doubled and undoubled. The Arabs say: ”رُبَّ رَجُلٍ جاءَنِي“ ("many a man has come to me"), and they lighten it and say: ”رُبَ رَجُلٍ“. Al-Ḥādira said:
؎فَسُمَيَّ ما يُدْرِيكِ أنْ رُبَ فِتْيَةٍ باكَرْتُ لَذَّتَهم بِأدْكَنَ مُتْرَعِ
(O Sumayy, how would you know that many a band of youths I have greeted early at their pleasure with a dark, brimming wineskin?)
He means ”سُمَيَّةَ“ (Sumayya), and he truncated it (tarkhīm).
And they make it quiescent in the lightened form, saying: ”رُبْ رَجُلٍ قَدْ جاءَنِي“; and they recited the verse of al-Hudhalī:
؎أزُهَيْرُ إنْ يَشِبِ القَذالُ فَإنَّنِي ∗∗∗ رُبْ هَيْضَلٍ لَجِبٍ لَفَفْتَ بِهَيْضَلِ
(O Zuhayr, if the back of my head turns grey, yet I — many a clamorous troop have you [sic] met with a troop.) [Translator's note: the verb is printed لَفَفْتَ (second person); the verse is usually cited with لَفَفْتُ, "I met".]
And they say: ”رُبَّتا رَجُلٍ“ and ”رُبَّتْ رَجُلٍ“; and they say ”رَبَّ رَجُلٍ“, with fatḥa on the rāʾ, and ”رَبَما رَجُلٍ جاءَنِي“ with fatḥa on the rāʾ, and ”رَبَّتَما رَجُلٍ“ with fatḥa. Quṭrub reported that.
As for the exegesis of the verse, there is more than one view on it. It has been said that on the Day of Resurrection, when the disbeliever sees the Resurrection with his own eyes, he will wish he had been a Muslim. It has been said that when he sees death with his own eyes, he will wish he were a Muslim. And it has been said that on the Day of Resurrection the Muslims will be brought out of the Fire, and those who disbelieved will wish they had been Muslims.
And it has been said: the disbelievers among the people of the Fire will taunt the Muslims, saying: "Your faith has not benefited you"; Allah, Mighty and Majestic is He, will be angered at that and will bring them out of the Fire, and those who disbelieved will wish they had been Muslims.
What I hold — and Allah knows best — is that whenever the disbeliever sees one of the states of punishment, and sees a state in which the states of the Muslim are [better], he wishes he had been a Muslim; so the verse can bear all these states.
If someone says: "Why is ”رُبَّ“ used here, when rubba is for paucity?", the answer to this is that the Arabs were addressed with what they understand in threatening.
A man threatens another man and says to him: ”لَعَلَّكَ سَتَنْدَمُ عَلى فِعْلِكَ“ ("perhaps you will regret your deed"), while he has no doubt that he will regret it; and you say to him: ”رُبَّما نَدِمَ الإنْسانُ مِن مِثْلِ ما صَنَعْتَ“ ("sometimes a person regrets the like of what you did"), while he knows that a person regrets [such things] often. But its figurative sense is that if this were something wished for in only one of the states of punishment, or if a person feared that he might regret something, it would be incumbent on him to avoid it. The evidence that it is in the sense of threat is His saying, Mighty and Majestic is He: ﴿ذَرْهم يَأْكُلُوا ويَتَمَتَّعُوا ويُلْهِهِمُ الأمَلُ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ﴾ [al-Ḥijr: 3]
And it is possible — and Allah knows best — that the terrors of the Day of Resurrection intoxicate them and distract them from wishing; then when they recover from one of the stupors of the punishment, they wish they had been Muslims.
As for whoever said that by ”رُبَّ“ abundance is meant, this is the opposite of what the philologists know, because particles that came for a meaning are as the Arabs established them: ”رُبَّ“ is established for paucity, and ”كَمْ“ is established for abundance; they were only addressed with what they understand and benefit from. ”ما“ was added to ”رُبَّ“ only so that the verb may follow it; you say ”رُبَّ رَجُلٍ جاءَنِي“ and ”رُبَّما جاءَنِي رَجُلٌ“.

zajjaj:4-4.t: And His saying, Mighty and Majestic is He: ﴿وَما أهْلَكْنا مِن قَرْيَةٍ إلا ولَها كِتابٌ مَعْلُومٌ﴾, i.e. except that it had a term which it neither precedes nor lags behind.

zajjaj:7-7.t: And His saying, Mighty and Majestic is He: ﴿لَوْ ما تَأْتِينا بِالمَلائِكَةِ﴾: its meaning is: "why do you not bring us the angels?" That is related: they said to the Prophet, upon him be peace: "Why has an angel not been sent down to him?"

zajjaj:8-8.t: So He said: ﴿ما نُنَـزِّلُ المَلائِكَةَ إلا بِالحَقِّ﴾, i.e. they only descend with appointed terms or with revelation from Allah. ﴿وَما كانُوا إذًا مُنْظَرِينَ﴾, i.e. had the angels descended, they would not have been given respite, and [the door of] repentance would have been cut off, as He said: ﴿وَلَوْ أنْـزَلْنا مَلَكًا لَقُضِيَ الأمْرُ ثُمَّ لا يُنْظَرُونَ﴾ [al-Anʿām: 8]. And it is read: ”ما تَنَزَّلُ المَلائِكَةُ إلّا بِالحَقِّ“, ”ما تُنَزِّلُ المَلائِكَةُ“, ”ما تُنَزَّلُ المَلائِكَةُ“ and ”ما تَنْزِلُ المَلائِكَةُ“.

zajjaj:9-9.t: And His saying: ﴿إنّا نَحْنُ نَـزَّلْنا الذِّكْرَ وإنّا لَهُ لَحافِظُونَ﴾, i.e. We guard it against any addition or deficiency occurring in it, as He said: ﴿لا يَأْتِيهِ الباطِلُ مِن بَيْنِ يَدَيْهِ ولا مِن خَلْفِهِ تَنْـزِيلٌ مِن حَكِيمٍ حَمِيدٍ﴾ [Fuṣṣilat: 42]

zajjaj:10-10.t: And His saying, Mighty and Majestic is He: ﴿فِي شِيَعِ الأوَّلِينَ﴾, i.e. among the sects of the ancients.

zajjaj:11-11.t: ﴿وَما يَأْتِيهِمْ مِن رَسُولٍ إلا كانُوا بِهِ يَسْتَهْزِئُونَ﴾: so Allah, Mighty and Majestic is He, made known that the fools of every nation mock its messengers.

zajjaj:12-12.t: ﴿كَذَلِكَ نَسْلُكُهُ في قُلُوبِ المُجْرِمِينَ﴾, and it is read ”نُسْلِكُهُ“, i.e. "thus We insert misguidance into the hearts of the criminals" [Translator's note: the source prints the paraphrase as ”نَسَلُكُ“], i.e. "just as was done with the criminals who mocked the messengers who came before, so do We insert misguidance (al-iḍlāl) into the hearts of the criminals".

zajjaj:13-13.t: Then He made that clear, saying: ﴿لا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِ وقَدْ خَلَتْ سُنَّةُ الأوَّلِينَ﴾, i.e. the way of the ancients has already passed with the like of what these have done, so they follow in their footsteps in disbelief.

zajjaj:14-14.t:
Then He, Exalted is He, made known to them that when the miraculous sign came to them they said: "magic", and they said: "our eyes have been dazzled", just as they said when the moon split: "this is continuous magic". So He said, Mighty and Majestic is He: ﴿وَلَوْ فَتَحْنا عَلَيْهِمْ بابًا مِنَ السَّماءِ فَظَلُّوا فِيهِ يَعْرُجُونَ﴾, and it is read ”يَعْرِجُونَ“, i.e. they ascend, go and come. ”يَعْرُجُونَ“ may refer to the angels or to the people; the exegesis has come with both. ﴿لَقالُوا إنَّما سُكِّرَتْ أبْصارُنا﴾ [al-Ḥijr: 15], and ”سُكِرَتْ“; and ”سَكَرَتْ“ with fatḥa on the sīn is permissible, but do not read it so unless a sound transmission establishes it. They explained ”سُكِّرَتْ“ as "covered over", and ”سَكِرَتْ“ as "bewildered, and stilled from looking". The Arabs say: ”سَكِرَتِ الرِّيحُ، تَسْكَرُ“ when the wind becomes still, and likewise ”سَكِرَ الحَرُّ، يَسْكَرُ“. The poet said:
؎جاءَ الشِّتاءُ واجْثَألَّ القُبَّرُ وجَعَلَتْ عَيْنُ الحَرُورِ تَسْكَرُ
(Winter has come, the larks have puffed themselves up, and the source of the hot wind has begun to grow still.)

zajjaj:16-16.t: And His saying, Mighty and Majestic is He: ﴿وَلَقَدْ جَعَلْنا في السَّماءِ بُرُوجًا﴾: it has come in the exegesis: "stars and planets"; and it has been said: "the stations of the sun and the moon". These zodiacal signs (burūj) that the astronomers call "the Camel" [Translator's note: so in the source, «الجمل»; the Ram (al-ḥamal) is presumably meant], "the Bull" and the like are also stars, their figures being in the shapes of their names' bearers. So the burūj are stars, as has come in the exegesis. ﴿وَحَفِظْناها مِن كُلِّ شَيْطانٍ رَجِيمٍ﴾ [al-Ḥijr: 17]: as for the meaning of ”رَجِيمٌ“, it has been said: "accursed"; and it may be "stoned, pelted with the stars", as He said, Mighty and Majestic is He: ﴿وَلَقَدْ زَيَّنّا السَّماءَ الدُّنْيا بِمَصابِيحَ وجَعَلْناها رُجُومًا لِلشَّياطِينِ﴾ [al-Mulk: 5]

zajjaj:18-18.t:
And His saying, Mighty and Majestic is He: ﴿إلا مَنِ اسْتَرَقَ السَّمْعَ﴾: the position of ”مَن“ is accusative, in the sense of "but whoever steals a hearing" [i.e. a disjoined exception]; and it may be in the position of the genitive, in the sense of "except from whoever steals a hearing". ﴿فَأتْبَعَهُ شِهابٌ مُبِينٌ﴾: ”اَلشُّهُبُ“ are the shooting stars, among the signs of Allah for the Prophet, upon him be peace. The evidence that they began shooting after the birth of the Prophet ﷺ is that the Arab poets, who used to make comparisons for speed with lightning, the torrent and swift things, — not a single verse is found in their poetry mentioning shooting stars; then when they occurred after the birth of the Prophet, upon him be peace, the poets began to mention them. Dhū al-Rumma said:
؎كَأنَّهُ كَوْكَبٌ في إثْرِ عِفْرِيَةٍ مُسَوَّمٌ في سَوادِ اللَّيْلِ مُنْقَضِبُ
(As though it were a star in pursuit of a demon, marked, darting off in the blackness of the night.)

zajjaj:19-19.t:
﴿والأرْضَ مَدَدْناها وألْقَيْنا فِيها رَواسِيَ وأنْبَتْنا فِيها مِن كُلِّ شَيْءٍ مَوْزُونٍ﴾: the earth was a lump of clay and was stretched out; and it has been said: "it was stretched out from beneath the Sacred House". ”اَلرَّواسِي“ are the firm mountains. The meaning of ﴿مِن كُلِّ شَيْءٍ مَوْزُونٍ﴾ is: of everything measured out, proceeding according to a weight from the decree of Allah, Mighty and Majestic is He, not exceeding what Allah has decreed for it; no creature can add to it or take from it. And it has been said: ”مِن كُلِّ شَيْءٍ مَوْزُونٍ“ means "of everything that is weighed", such as iron, lead, copper and arsenic.
﴿وَجَعَلْنا لَكم فِيها مَعايِشَ ومَن لَسْتُمْ لَهُ بِرازِقِينَ﴾ [al-Ḥijr: 20]: the position of ”مَن“ is accusative from two angles. One of them is conjunction with ”مَعايِشَ“, the meaning being: "and We made for you those for whom you are not providers". And it may be conjoined to the interpreted sense of ”لَكُمْ“, the meaning being: "by Our making for you means of livelihood in it, We sustained you and those for whom you are not providers". In the exegesis, ”مَن لَسْتُمْ لَهُ بِرازِقِينَ“ are the riding animals and the livestock.
And it has been said in some exegesis: the wild beasts. The grammarians hold that ”مَن“ is hardly ever used for what lacks reason; yet He has said, Mighty and Majestic is He: ﴿فَمِنهم مَن يَمْشِي عَلى بَطْنِهِ ومِنهم مَن يَمْشِي عَلى رِجْلَيْنِ ومِنهم مَن يَمْشِي عَلى أرْبَعٍ﴾ [al-Nūr: 45], so ”مَن“ came for other than people, since others than people were described with their attributes, just as the wāw [of the plural] came for other than people in His saying: ﴿وَكُلٌّ في فَلَكٍ يَسْبَحُونَ﴾ [Yā Sīn: 40].
The best — and Allah knows best — is that ”مَن“ here — I mean ”وَمَن لَسْتُمْ لَهُ بِرازِقِينَ“ — is meant for slaves, livestock and riding animals, so the meaning is: "We made for you means of livelihood in it, and We made for you slaves, riding animals and livestock, and you have been spared the burden of providing for them".

zajjaj:22-22.t: And His saying, Mighty and Majestic is He: ﴿وَأرْسَلْنا الرِّياحَ لَواقِحَ﴾: ”لَواقِحَ“ — they bring the clouds; and ”لَواقِحَ“ — they fertilise the clouds and fertilise the trees. It is permissible to say of the wind ”لَقَّحَتْ“ ("it became pregnant") when it brings good, just as it is called ”عَقِيمٌ“ ("barren") when it brings no good and brings punishment, as He said, Mighty and Majestic is He: ﴿وَفِي عادٍ إذْ أرْسَلْنا عَلَيْهِمُ الرِّيحَ العَقِيمَ﴾ [al-Dhāriyāt: 41]. And it is permissible to call them ”لَواقِحُ“ even though they fertilise other things, because its meaning is attribution (nasab) [i.e. "possessed of fertilising"].

zajjaj:24-24.t: And His saying, Mighty and Majestic is He: ﴿وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْنا المُسْتَقْدِمِينَ مِنكم ولَقَدْ عَلِمْنا المُسْتَأْخِرِينَ﴾: more than one view has been stated about it. It has been said: those who go before are those whom He has created, and those who come later are those of creation who will come into being until the Day of Resurrection.

zajjaj:25-25.t:
Then He said: ﴿وَإنَّ رَبَّكَ هو يَحْشُرُهُمْ﴾, i.e. He who brought them into being and knew them is the One who will gather them, resurrected, just as He began them at the first creation. ﴿إنَّهُ حَكِيمٌ عَلِيمٌ﴾, i.e. His governance proceeds with wisdom and knowledge. It has also been said: "We know those of you who go forward in obedience to Allah and those who hold back in it". And it has been said that there was a beautiful woman who prayed behind the Messenger of Allah ﷺ among the women who prayed, and some of those who prayed would hold back in the last rows, and when he prostrated he would look at her from beneath his armpit; while those who did not have this aim would seek to be forward in the rows because of the merit in that.
﴿قالَ هَذا صِراطٌ عَلَيَّ مُسْتَقِيمٌ﴾ [al-Ḥijr: 41]: whoever reads ”صِراطٌ عَلَيَّ مُسْتَقِيمٌ“, the meaning is: "this is a straight path [leading] to Me", i.e. according to My will and My command; and whoever reads ”عَلِيٌّ“ means: a lofty path in religion and truth.

zajjaj:26-26.t:
And His saying: ﴿مِن صَلْصالٍ مِن حَمَإٍ مَسْنُونٍ﴾: ”اَلصَّلَصالُ“ [Translator's note: so vocalised in the source] is dry clay that rings (yaṣillu) because of its dryness; and the meaning of ”يَصِلُّ“ is "makes a sound". The poet said:
؎رَجَعْتُ إلى صَدْرٍ كَجَرَّةِ حَنْتِمٍ إذا قُرِعَتْ صِفْرًا مِنَ الماءِ صَلَّتِ
(I returned to a breast like a green earthenware jar: when it is struck, empty of water, it rings.)
And about ”مَسْنُونٍ“ it has been said: altered [i.e. foul-smelling]; it was only taken from its being on the course (sunna) of the road, because it only becomes altered when it stands without running water.

zajjaj:27-27.t: ﴿والجانَّ خَلَقْناهُ مِن قَبْلُ مِن نارِ السَّمُومِ﴾: ”اَلْجانَّ“ is accusative by an implied verb; the meaning is: "and We created the jinn, We created them". Allah created the angels from the light of might, created Ādam from dust, and created the jinn from the fire of scorching wind (al-samūm).

zajjaj:30-30.t: And His saying, Mighty and Majestic is He: ﴿فَسَجَدَ المَلائِكَةُ كُلُّهم أجْمَعُونَ﴾: Sībawayh and al-Khalīl said: ”أجْمَعُونَ“ is tawkīd (emphasis) after tawkīd. Muḥammad ibn Yazīd [al-Mubarrad] said: ”أجْمَعُونَ“ indicates their being together in prostration, the meaning being: "they all prostrated at one and the same moment". The view of Sībawayh and al-Khalīl is better, because ”أجْمَعِينَ“ is definite and so cannot be a ḥāl (circumstantial).

zajjaj:31-31.t: ﴿إلا إبْلِيسَ﴾: ”إبْلِيسَ“ is excepted, and he is not of the angels; he is only of the jinn, as He said, Mighty and Majestic is He: ﴿إلا إبْلِيسَ كانَ مِنَ الجِنِّ فَفَسَقَ عَنْ أمْرِ رَبِّهِ﴾ [al-Kahf: 50].
